name: Framer student plan
summary: A one-year Framer student discount with hosting for a personal portfolio site.
how: Apply with your name, school, school email, expected graduation date and a photo of your student ID.
catches: Only new customers can redeem coupon codes.
Page says hosting is worth $120 per year but doesn't state the discount amount.

evidence.quote: You can re-apply for a new Student discount every 11 months for as long as you are a student.
Students must be enrolled in a certified in-person or online program, like a high school, college, or university.
